name: Ambericity
description: Earth Affinity: You have resistance to earth dmg.

system.effect:
Upcast: Your power requires +1 action to use
On cast:
Heals 2d4 hp (3d4, if upcast)

On check success:
Heals additional 2d4 + (lvl * 1) hp
(3d4 + (lvl * 1), if upcast)

system.description: The user accumulates amber energy in his body and transforms them into a stream of regenerative current. This current only heals when kept at a specific level. If one fails in controlling the level of the current, it is easy to hurt yourself.
system.effect:
On save 0% - 30%: Deals 2d6
On save 30% - 100%: Heals 5d6

system.description: The user collects surrounding amber energy and releases it at a target of his choice. This ambergy is hard to control and even harder to direct. Depending on how well the user fares in controlling his force, the ambergy releases in different forms: Either a weak flame, a zap or a thunderstrike.
system.effect:
On hit: 
If attack hits 0% - 50%: Deals 3d6 + (lvl * 1) earth dmg
If attack hits 50% - 99%: Deals 5d6 + (lvl * 2) earth dmg
If attack crits: Deals 10d6 + (lvl * 2) earth dmg

system.description: The user manipulates the electrons on the outer layer of the given object, thereby charging it. By shooting these objects, the user imparts an impulse to inflict one of the specified effects using their own electric field.
system.effect:
On cast:
Up to 3 projectiles gain one of the effects of your choice:
3m radius · Ground Circle
Target Save Con · Instant
On beginning of targets turn:
Paralyze targets for 1 turn (none when Save succeeded)
Paralyze removes 1 action of the enemy next turn. This does not stack.
3m radius · Ground Circle
Target Save Wil · Instant
On beginning of targets turn:
Confuse targets for 1 turn (none when Save succeeded)
Confuse forces the target to roll a D8 and choose his next action into the direction of the D8 (beginning north clockwise)
3m radius · Ground Circle
Target Save Con · Instant
On beginning of targets turn:
Prone targets (none when Save succeeded)
